description: This source file defines the interface 'ReconnectConfig' and nested interfaces and enums related to configuration settings for reconnect behavior in the Eclipse Ditto service's connectivity messaging component. It includes methods for obtaining delays, intervals, batch sizes, and rate configurations, along with default values and config path information.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration accessors for reconnect behavior settings.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig.ReconnectConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining configuration keys and default values for 'ReconnectConfig'.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig.RateConfig
classes.description: Nested interface specifying configuration for recovery throttling and its default values.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig.RateConfig.RateConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining configuration keys and defaults for 'RateConfig'.

methods.name: getInitialDelay
methods.description: Returns the initial delay Duration for reconnection attempts after the actor starts.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval Duration used for trying to reconnect all connections.

methods.name: getReadJournalBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the number of events to read in a single journal query.

methods.name: getRateConfig
methods.description: Returns the RateConfig instance governing recovery throttling.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the Duration representing how frequently recovery attempts are made.

methods.name: getEntityAmount
methods.description: Returns the number of entities to recover per batch.
